State is data the component owns and can change. useState returns the current value and a setter. Call the setter to update. Do not change the state object in place.
When state changes, React calculates the new UI and updates the DOM for you.
hindi: Props parent se aane wale inputs hain. Child unhe read-only maane. Parent naya name de to React child ko dubara render karta hai.
State woh data hai jo component ke paas hai aur badal sakta hai. useState current value aur setter deta hai. Update ke liye setter call karo. State object ko seedha mat badlo.
State badalte hi React naya UI nikalta hai aur DOM khud update karta hai.

lessons.title: Lists and events
english: Render a list with map. Each item needs a stable key so React can match items when the list changes. The key should come from the data, not from the array index, when items can move or be deleted.
Events use camelCase names such as onClick and onChange. The handler receives a synthetic event. Call preventDefault on a form submit if you handle it in JavaScript.
Lift shared state to the closest parent that needs it, then pass values and setters down as props.
hindi: List map se render hoti hai. Har item ko stable key chahiye, taaki list badle to React items ko pehchan sake. Jab items move ya delete ho sakte hain, key data se aani chahiye, index se nahi.
Events ke naam camelCase hote hain, jaise onClick aur onChange. Handler ko event milta hai. Form submit JavaScript se handle karo to preventDefault call karo.
Shared state us sabse nazdeek parent par rakho jise uski zaroorat hai, phir values aur setters props se neeche bhejo.

lessons.title: useState
english: useState(start) keeps a value that can change. It returns the current value and a setter. Call the setter with the next value, or with a function that receives the previous value. React renders the component again after the setter runs.
Do not change state in place. For an object or array, pass a new one. Several set calls in the same event are grouped, so use the function form when the next value depends on the previous one.
What you see: the button starts as Count 0. Each click shows Count 1, then Count 2.
hindi: useState(start) woh value rakhta hai jo badal sakti hai. Ye current value aur setter deta hai. Setter ko next value do, ya ek function do jo previous value leta hai. Setter ke baad React component dubara render karta hai.
State ko seedha mat badlo. Object ya array ho to naya object do. Next value previous par depend kare to function form use karo.
Screen: button Count 0 se shuru hota hai. Har click par Count 1, phir Count 2.

lessons.title: useEffect
english: useEffect(fn, deps) runs fn after the browser paints. An empty dependency array [] runs once after the first paint. No array runs after every paint. An array of values runs again when one of those values changes.
Return a function from the effect to clean up. React calls that function before the effect runs again and when the component is removed. Use it to remove a listener or ignore a late response.
What you see: after the first paint, the console prints loaded Ada. If userId changes from 1 to 2, the cleanup runs and then the effect prints the next user.
hindi: useEffect paint ke baad chalta hai. [] pehli paint ke baad ek baar chalta hai. Bina array ke har paint ke baad chalta hai. Values ki array tab dubara chalti hai jab koi value badle.
Effect se function return karo to woh cleanup hai. React use agle effect se pehle aur component hatne par chalata hai.
Screen: pehli paint ke baad console loaded Ada print karta hai.

lessons.title: useRef
english: useRef(start) returns an object { current: start }. Changing current does not render the component again. Use it for a DOM node, a timer id, or any value that must survive the next render without being state.
Pass the ref to a DOM element with the ref prop. After paint, inputRef.current is that element. Call focus() on it.
What you see: clicking Focus puts the cursor in the input. The component does not re-render just because current changed.
hindi: useRef ek object deta hai jiska current badal sakta hai. current badalne se render nahi hota. DOM node, timer id, ya aisi value ke liye use karo jo agle render tak rehni chahiye.
ref prop se DOM element milta hai. Paint ke baad current woh element hai. focus() call kar sakte ho.
Screen: Focus click karne par cursor input mein chala jata hai.

lessons.title: useReducer
english: useReducer(reducer, start) is for state that changes in named steps. The reducer receives the current state and an action and must return the next state. dispatch(action) asks React to run the reducer.
Use it when several values change together, or when the next state depends on the kind of action, such as increment, decrement, or reset.
What you see: the number starts at 0. Increment shows 1. Reset shows 0 again.
hindi: useReducer named steps se state badalta hai. Reducer current state aur action leta hai aur next state return karta hai. dispatch action bhejta hai.
Jab kai values saath badlen, ya next state action ke type par depend kare, tab use karo.
Screen: number 0 se shuru hota hai. Increment 1 dikhata hai. Reset 0 dikhata hai.

lessons.title: useContext
english: createContext(defaultValue) makes a context. Provider value={data} publishes data to components below it. useContext(Context) reads the nearest Provider. If there is no Provider, you get the default value.
Use context for data many components need, such as the signed-in user or the theme. Do not use it for every piece of state. Props are clearer when only one child needs the value.
What you see: inside the Provider, the paragraph shows Ada. A component outside the Provider shows the default Guest.
hindi: createContext context banata hai. Provider value neeche ke components ko data deta hai. useContext nazdeek ka Provider padhta hai. Provider na ho to default value milti hai.
User ya theme jaise data ke liye context use karo jo kai components ko chahiye. Sirf ek child ko value chahiye to props saaf hain.
Screen: Provider ke andar Ada dikhta hai. Bahar Guest dikhta hai.

lessons.title: useMemo and useCallback
english: useMemo(fn, deps) remembers the result of fn until a dependency changes. Use it for an expensive calculation, not for every value. useCallback(fn, deps) remembers the function itself so a child that is wrapped in memo does not render again only because the parent made a new function.
If the dependencies are wrong, you will show a stale value. Include every value from the component that the function uses.
What you see: total stays 60 while the component renders for an unrelated reason. It is recalculated only when prices changes.
hindi: useMemo fn ka result yaad rakhta hai jab tak dependency na badle. Mehngi calculation ke liye use karo. useCallback function ko yaad rakhta hai taaki memo wala child sirf naye function ki wajah se dubara render na ho.
Dependencies galat hon to purani value dikhegi. Function jo values use kare unhe array mein rakho.
Screen: prices na badle to total 60 rehta hai.

lessons.title: useId
english: useId() returns a stable id string for accessibility. Use it to connect a label to an input with htmlFor and id. Do not use it as a list key. List keys come from your data.
The id is the same on the server and the client, so it does not cause a hydration mismatch. Each useId() call in a component returns a different id.
What you see: clicking the label Name focuses the input, because the label's htmlFor matches the input id.
hindi: useId accessibility ke liye stable id deta hai. label ke htmlFor aur input ke id ko jodo. Ise list key mat banao. List key data se aani chahiye.
Ye id server aur client par same rehti hai. Ek component mein har useId() alag id deta hai.
Screen: Name label click karne par input focus ho jata hai.

lessons.title: use
english: use(promise) reads a promise during render. React suspends until the promise settles, then continues with the value. The nearest Suspense boundary shows the fallback while it waits. use(context) reads context and, unlike useContext, can be called inside an if.
Do not create the promise inside the component on every render, or React will start a new request each time. Create it outside, or store it.
What you see: the fallback Loading shows first. When the promise resolves to Ada, the paragraph replaces the fallback.
hindi: use(promise) render ke dauran promise padhta hai. Promise settle hone tak React rukta hai. Nazdeek ka Suspense fallback dikhata hai. use(context) context padhta hai aur if ke andar call ho sakta hai.
Promise ko har render par component ke andar mat banao, warna har baar naya request shuru hoga.
Screen: pehle Loading dikhta hai. Promise Ada de to paragraph Loading ki jagah aa jata hai.

lessons.title: Conditional rendering
english: Use && when you want to render something only if a value is truthy. Use a ternary when both branches render different UI. Return null when the component should render nothing.
Do not put a number like 0 on the left of &&. React will print 0. Use a boolean, such as items.length > 0.
What you see: count 0 shows the empty paragraph. count 2 shows the list paragraph.
hindi: && tab use karo jab sirf truthy value par kuch dikhana ho. Ternary tab use karo jab dono branches alag UI dikhayen. Kuch na dikhana ho to null return karo.
&& ke left mein 0 mat rakho. React 0 print kar dega. items.length > 0 jaisa boolean use karo.
Screen: count 0 par empty paragraph. count 2 par list paragraph.

lessons.title: Fragments and children
english: A fragment, written <>...</> or <Fragment>, groups elements without adding a DOM node. Use a fragment with a key when a list item returns more than one element.
props.children is whatever you place between the opening and closing tags. A layout component renders {children} where the nested content should appear.
What you see: Card prints a heading and then the paragraph you nested inside it. The fragment adds no extra wrapper in the DOM.
hindi: Fragment elements ko bina extra DOM node ke group karta hai. List item ek se zyada element return kare to key wala fragment use karo.
props.children woh hai jo opening aur closing tag ke beech likho. Layout {children} wahan render karta hai jahan nested content aana chahiye.
Screen: Card heading dikhata hai aur andar ka paragraph bhi.

lessons.title: Controlled inputs
english: A controlled input stores its text in state. value is the state. onChange reads event.target.value and calls the setter. React is the source of the text, so you can validate it or clear it.
A checkbox uses checked instead of value, and event.target.checked. A select uses value the same way as a text input.
What you see: the input starts empty. Typing Ada shows Ada in the paragraph under the field.
hindi: Controlled input apna text state mein rakhta hai. value state hai. onChange event.target.value padh kar setter call karta hai. Text React ke paas hai, isliye use check ya clear kar sakte ho.
Checkbox checked use karta hai, value nahi. select text input ki tarah value use karta hai.
Screen: input khaali shuru hota hai. Ada likhne par neeche Ada dikhta hai.

lessons.title: Submit and preventDefault
english: A form onSubmit handler receives the event. Call event.preventDefault() or the browser will reload the page. Read the state you already stored, or use FormData when the inputs are not controlled.
Disable the submit button while a request is in flight so the user cannot send the form twice. Show the error from a failed request next to the form.
What you see: submitting the name Ada does not reload the page. The paragraph under the form becomes Saved Ada.
hindi: onSubmit ko event milta hai. event.preventDefault() call karo warna browser page reload kar deta hai. State padho, ya uncontrolled inputs ke liye FormData use karo.
Request chal rahi ho to submit button disable karo taaki form do baar na jaaye.
Screen: Ada submit karne par page reload nahi hota. Paragraph Saved Ada ho jata hai.

lessons.title: memo
english: memo(Component) skips rendering that component when its props are the same as last time, compared with Object.is. Use it when a child is slow and the parent renders often with the same props.
A new object or a new function created during the parent render counts as a changed prop. Pass a stable value, or remember the function with useCallback, if you want the skip to work.
What you see: clicking a parent button does not print render row when the row's item prop is the same object as last time. Changing the item prints render row.
hindi: memo tab component ko skip karta hai jab props pichhli baar jaisi hon. Slow child aur aksar render hone wale parent ke liye use karo.
Render ke dauran naya object ya naya function badli hui prop maana jata hai. Skip chahiye to stable value do ya useCallback use karo.
Screen: parent ka button row ko dubara render nahi karta jab item wahi ho. Item badlo to render row print hota hai.

title: Next.js
summary: Pages, layouts, and the split between server and client.

lessons.title: The app router
english: In the app directory, a folder is a route and page.tsx is the screen. app/dashboard/page.tsx becomes /dashboard.
A folder in parentheses, such as (public), groups routes without changing the URL. A folder in square brackets, such as [slug], is a dynamic segment.
You can export metadata from a page so the title and description stay with that route.
hindi: app directory mein folder route hai aur page.tsx screen hai. app/dashboard/page.tsx ka URL /dashboard hota hai.
Parentheses wala folder, jaise (public), routes ko group karta hai bina URL badle. Square brackets wala folder, jaise [slug], dynamic segment hai.
Page se metadata export kar sakte ho, taaki title aur description usi route ke saath rahein.

lessons.title: Layouts and links
english: layout.tsx wraps the pages in that segment. It stays mounted when you move between child routes, so shared chrome like a sidebar does not remount every time.
Use the Link component for in-app navigation. It prefetches the next page and avoids a full browser reload.
usePathname tells a client component which URL is active, which is how a nav item shows the current page.
hindi: layout.tsx us segment ke pages ko wrap karta hai. Child routes ke beech jaane par ye mounted rehta hai, isliye sidebar har baar dubara mount nahi hota.
App ke andar navigation ke liye Link use karo. Ye agla page prefetch karta hai aur poora browser reload nahi karta.
usePathname client component ko batata hai kaunsa URL active hai. Isi se nav item current page dikhata hai.

lessons.title: Server and client components
english: Components in the app router are server components by default. They can read files and secrets and they do not ship their logic to the browser.
Add use client at the top when you need state, effects, or browser events. Keep that boundary as low in the tree as you can.
A server layout can pass a server page as children into a client shell. That is how this dashboard protects pages and still renders lesson content on the server.
hindi: App router mein components by default server components hote hain. Ye files aur secrets padh sakte hain, aur unka logic browser ko nahi jaata.
State, effects, ya browser events chahiye hon to file ke top par use client likho. Ye boundary tree mein jitni neeche ho sake, utni neeche rakho.
Server layout ek server page ko children ki tarah client shell mein bhej sakta hai. Isi tarah ye dashboard pages ko protect karta hai aur lessons server par render karta hai.

lessons.title: useRouter
english: useRouter from next/navigation is for a client component that must change the URL from code, such as after a button click. Import it only in a file that starts with use client.

push(href) opens the route and adds a history entry. replace(href) opens it without a new entry. back() and forward() walk the history. refresh() asks the server for a new render of this route and keeps client state such as useState.
Prefer Link when the user is clicking a known URL. Use the router when the next URL depends on something that just happened.
What you see: clicking Open dashboard changes the address bar to /dashboard without a full page reload.
hindi: useRouter client component ke liye hai jab code se URL badalna ho, jaise button click ke baad. Ise sirf us file mein import karo jiske top par use client ho.

push(href) route kholta hai aur history mein entry jodta hai. replace(href) nayi entry nahi jodta. back() aur forward() history par chalte hain. refresh() server se naya render mangta hai aur useState jaisa client state rehne deta hai.
Jab URL pehle se pata ho to Link use karo. Router tab use karo jab next URL abhi hue kaam par depend kare.
Screen: Open dashboard click karne par address bar /dashboard ho jata hai, poora reload nahi hota.

lessons.title: usePathname and useParams
english: usePathname() returns the path without the query string. /dashboard/react?tab=hooks returns /dashboard/react. Use it to mark the nav item that matches the current page.

useParams() returns the dynamic segments of the URL as strings. On app/dashboard/[slug]/page.tsx, the URL /dashboard/react gives { slug: "react" }. These hooks belong in client components. A server page reads the same segment by awaiting its params prop.
What you see: on /dashboard/react the paragraph shows /dashboard/react and the slug react.
hindi: usePathname() query string ke bina path deta hai. /dashboard/react?tab=hooks se /dashboard/react milta hai. Isi se current nav item highlight hota hai.

useParams() URL ke dynamic segments strings mein deta hai. app/dashboard/[slug]/page.tsx par /dashboard/react se { slug: "react" } milta hai. Ye hooks client components ke hain. Server page wahi segment apne params prop ko await karke padhta hai.
Screen: /dashboard/react par paragraph /dashboard/react aur slug react dikhata hai.

lessons.title: useSearchParams
english: useSearchParams() reads the query string in a client component. It returns a read-only URLSearchParams. get("tab") on /dashboard/react?tab=hooks returns hooks. get returns null when the key is missing.
Do not write the query with this hook. Build the next query with URLSearchParams and pass it to router.push, or use a Link whose href already includes the query.
A page that calls this hook during a static render should sit under a Suspense boundary, or the whole route opts into dynamic rendering.
What you see: the address /dashboard/react?tab=hooks shows the text tab hooks.
hindi: useSearchParams() client component mein query string padhta hai. Ye read-only URLSearchParams deta hai. /dashboard/react?tab=hooks par get("tab") hooks deta hai. Key na ho to null milta hai.
Is hook se query mat likho. Next query URLSearchParams se banao aur router.push ko do, ya Link ka href pehle se query ke saath rakho.
Jo page is hook ko static render mein call kare use Suspense ke andar rakho, warna poora route dynamic ho jata hai.
Screen: /dashboard/react?tab=hooks par text tab hooks dikhta hai.

lessons.title: redirect and notFound
english: redirect(path) from next/navigation stops the current render and sends the user to path. It does not return a value, so do not write code after it. In a Server Action the default history behavior is push. Elsewhere the default is replace. Pass RedirectType.push or RedirectType.replace when you need the other one.

notFound() stops the render and shows the nearest not-found file. Use it when the id in the URL does not match a record. permanentRedirect(path) is the same idea as redirect, with a permanent status for a URL that has moved for good.
What you see: a missing library calls notFound() and the not-found screen appears. A signed-out check that calls redirect("/login") changes the address bar to /login.
hindi: redirect(path) current render rok kar user ko path par bhejta hai. Ye value return nahi karta, isliye uske baad code mat likho. Server Action mein default history push hai. Baaki jagah default replace hai. Doosra chahiye to RedirectType.push ya RedirectType.replace do.
notFound() render rok kar nazdeek ki not-found file dikhata hai. URL ka id record se na mile to ise call karo. permanentRedirect us URL ke liye hai jo hamesha ke liye move ho chuka hai.
Screen: missing library par notFound() not-found screen dikhata hai. redirect("/login") address bar ko /login kar deta hai.

lessons.title: cookies
english: cookies() from next/headers reads the request cookies on the server. In this version it is async, so write const store = await cookies(). It works in a Server Component, a Server Action, and a Route Handler. It does not work in a client component.

get(name) returns { name, value } or undefined. has(name) is a boolean. getAll() lists the cookies. set(name, value, options) and delete(name) change the response, so use them in a Server Action or a Route Handler, not while rendering a page.
httpOnly keeps the cookie off document.cookie. secure sends it only on HTTPS. sameSite controls when the browser attaches it to another site's request.
What you see: a request whose Cookie header contains theme=dark makes the paragraph show dark.
hindi: cookies() next/headers se server par request cookies padhta hai. Is version mein ye async hai, isliye const store = await cookies() likho. Ye Server Component, Server Action, aur Route Handler mein chalta hai. Client component mein nahi.

get(name) { name, value } ya undefined deta hai. has(name) boolean hai. getAll() list deta hai. set aur delete response badalte hain, isliye unhe Server Action ya Route Handler mein call karo, page render karte waqt nahi.
httpOnly cookie ko document.cookie se chhupata hai. secure use sirf HTTPS par bhejta hai. sameSite batata hai browser use doosri site ki request ke saath kab jode.
Screen: Cookie header mein theme=dark ho to paragraph dark dikhata hai.

lessons.title: headers
english: headers() from next/headers reads the incoming request headers on the server. It is async. const list = await headers() then list.get("user-agent"). Names are lowercase.

Reading headers opts the route into dynamic rendering, because the value can change on every request. Do not call it from a client component. You can read headers here. Setting response headers belongs on a Route Handler response or on cookies().set.
What you see: a browser request prints a user-agent string such as Mozilla/5.0 in the paragraph.
hindi: headers() server par aane wale request headers padhta hai. Ye async hai. const list = await headers() ke baad list.get("user-agent"). Naam lowercase hote hain.

headers padhne se route dynamic ho jata hai, kyunki value har request par badal sakti hai. Client component se call mat karo. Yahan headers padh sakte ho. Response headers Route Handler ya cookies().set par set hote hain.
Screen: browser request par paragraph mein Mozilla/5.0 jaisa user-agent dikhta hai.

lessons.title: fetch
english: Server components can call fetch. Next extends it with a cache option. force-cache keeps the response and reuses it. no-store fetches again on each request. next: { revalidate: 60 } means the cached response may be reused for 60 seconds, then the next request refreshes it.
next: { tags: ["lessons"] } names the cache entry so revalidateTag("lessons") can drop it later. Do not put secrets in a URL that gets cached and logged.
What you see: the first request stores { title: "Routing" }. A later request inside the revalidate window shows the same title without calling the API again.
hindi: Server components fetch call kar sakte hain. Next usme cache option jodta hai. force-cache response rakh kar dobara use karta hai. no-store har request par naya fetch karta hai. next: { revalidate: 60 } ka matlab cached response 60 second tak reuse ho sakta hai, phir agla request use refresh karta hai.
next: { tags: ["lessons"] } cache entry ko naam deta hai taaki revalidateTag("lessons") use baad mein hata sake. Secret ko aise URL mein mat daalo jo cache aur log ho.
Screen: pehla request { title: "Routing" } store karta hai. revalidate window ke andar agla request wahi title dikhata hai, API dubara call nahi hoti.

lessons.title: generateStaticParams
english: generateStaticParams builds the list of dynamic URLs at build time. In app/dashboard/[slug]/page.tsx, return an array of objects whose keys match the folder name. [{ slug: "react" }, { slug: "next-js" }] produces /dashboard/react and /dashboard/next-js.

The page still receives params as a Promise. await params to read slug. A slug that was not in the list can still render on demand, unless you set dynamicParams to false, in which case unknown slugs call notFound().
What you see: after the build, /dashboard/react and /dashboard/next-js are ready. Opening /dashboard/react shows the heading react.
hindi: generateStaticParams build time par dynamic URLs ki list banata hai. app/dashboard/[slug]/page.tsx mein un objects ki array return karo jinki key folder ke naam se match kare. [{ slug: "react" }, { slug: "next-js" }] se /dashboard/react aur /dashboard/next-js bante hain.

Page ko params phir bhi Promise milta hai. slug padhne ke liye await params karo. Jo slug list mein na ho wo on demand render ho sakta hai. dynamicParams false ho to unknown slug notFound() call karta hai.
Screen: build ke baad /dashboard/react aur /dashboard/next-js ready hote hain. /dashboard/react par heading react dikhti hai.

lessons.title: generateMetadata
english: Export a metadata object for a title and description that do not depend on the request. Export async function generateMetadata({ params }) when the title comes from data. Await params the same way the page does. The returned title becomes the document title.
Do not fetch the same record twice if both the page and generateMetadata need it. Share one function. metadata and generateMetadata in the same file are not combined. Use one of them.
What you see: /dashboard/react sets the browser tab title to React.
hindi: Jo title aur description request par depend na kare unke liye metadata object export karo. Title data se aaye to async function generateMetadata({ params }) export karo. params ko page ki tarah await karo. Return hua title document title ban jata hai.
Page aur generateMetadata dono ko wahi record chahiye to use do baar fetch mat karo. Ek function share karo. Ek hi file mein metadata aur generateMetadata saath nahi chalte. Ek use karo.
Screen: /dashboard/react browser tab ka title React kar deta hai.

lessons.title: Server Actions
english: A file that starts with use server exports functions that run on the server when the client calls them. The function must be async. Pass it to a form action or call it from a client event. Form fields arrive as FormData. formData.get("title") is the input named title.

Check the user inside the action. The client can call any exported action, so do not trust hidden fields for permission. After a write, call revalidatePath so the next render sees the new data, or redirect to the page that shows it.
What you see: submitting the title Hooks does not reload the whole document. The following render of /dashboard shows Hooks.
hindi: Jis file ke top par use server ho, uske exported functions client ke call par server par chalte hain. Function async hona chahiye. Use form ke action mein do ya client event se call karo. Fields FormData mein aate hain. formData.get("title") us input ki value hai jiska name title hai.

User ki check action ke andar karo. Client koi bhi exported action call kar sakta hai, isliye permission ke liye hidden field par bharosa mat karo. Write ke baad revalidatePath call karo taaki agla render naya data dikhaye, ya us page par redirect karo jo use dikhata hai.
Screen: title Hooks submit karne par poora document reload nahi hota. /dashboard ka agla render Hooks dikhata hai.

lessons.title: Route handlers
english: app/api/lessons/route.ts is a web endpoint, not a page. Export async functions named GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, or OPTIONS. Each receives a Request and returns a Response. Response.json({ ok: true }) sets the JSON body and the JSON content type.

Read a JSON body with await request.json(). Read a query with new URL(request.url).searchParams. This file has no JSX. Use a page when the result is HTML, and a route handler when the result is JSON for another client.
What you see: GET /api/lessons returns status 200 and the body {"title":"Routing"}. POST /api/lessons with {"title":"Hooks"} returns status 201.
hindi: app/api/lessons/route.ts ek web endpoint hai, page nahi. GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, ya OPTIONS naam ke async functions export karo. Har ek ko Request milta hai aur Response return karna hota hai. Response.json({ ok: true }) JSON body aur JSON content type set karta hai.
JSON body await request.json() se padho. Query new URL(request.url).searchParams se padho. Is file mein JSX nahi hota. HTML ke liye page use karo, aur doosre client ke JSON ke liye route handler.
Screen: GET /api/lessons status 200 aur body {"title":"Routing"} deta hai. POST {"title":"Hooks"} status 201 deta hai.

lessons.title: revalidatePath and revalidateTag
english: revalidatePath(path) from next/cache marks a cached route stale. Call it in a Server Action or a Route Handler after data changes. revalidatePath("/dashboard") refreshes that page. For a dynamic folder, pass the pattern and a type: revalidatePath("/dashboard/[slug]", "page").
revalidateTag("lessons") marks every fetch that was stored with next: { tags: ["lessons"] }. Use a tag when many pages share one request. The next visit loads fresh data.
What you see: after the action runs, opening /dashboard shows the lesson you just saved, not the copy from before the write.
hindi: revalidatePath(path) cached route ko stale mark karta hai. Data badalne ke baad ise Server Action ya Route Handler mein call karo. revalidatePath("/dashboard") us page ko refresh karta hai. Dynamic folder ke liye pattern aur type do: revalidatePath("/dashboard/[slug]", "page").

revalidateTag("lessons") har us fetch ko mark karta hai jo next: { tags: ["lessons"] } ke saath store hua tha. Tag tab use karo jab kai pages ek hi request share karen. Agla visit naya data load karta hai.
Screen: action ke baad /dashboard woh lesson dikhata hai jo abhi save hua, write se pehle wali copy nahi.

lessons.title: loading, error, and not-found
english: loading.tsx in a route folder shows its UI immediately while the page waits on data. Next wraps the page in Suspense for you. It does not replace the layout, so the shell stays on screen.

error.tsx must be a client component. It receives error and reset. reset() renders the segment again. A not-found.tsx file is the UI for notFound() and for an unknown URL under that segment. The root app/not-found.tsx covers the whole site.
What you see: a slow page shows Loading lessons first, then the heading. A thrown error shows the error screen and Try again. An unknown slug shows This page does not exist.
hindi: Route folder ki loading.tsx page ke data ka wait karte waqt turant UI dikhati hai. Next page ko Suspense mein wrap kar deta hai. Layout replace nahi hota, isliye shell screen par rehta hai.

error.tsx client component hona chahiye. Use error aur reset milte hain. reset() segment ko dubara render karta hai. not-found.tsx us segment ke notFound() aur unknown URL ka UI hai. Root app/not-found.tsx poori site cover karti hai.
Screen: slow page pehle Loading lessons dikhata hai, phir heading. Thrown error par error screen aur Try again. Unknown slug par This page does not exist.

lessons.title: Image
english: Image from next/image renders a picture and resizes it for the screen. A local file in public, such as public/logo.svg, is src="/logo.svg". Width and height are required for a static import size that is not fill, so the browser can reserve space and avoid a layout jump.

alt is the text for someone who cannot see the image. Use an empty alt only when the picture is decorative. priority on the largest image of the first screen loads it sooner. sizes tells the browser which width to download when the image uses fill.
What you see: the logo appears at 32 by 32 CSS pixels. The layout does not jump when the file finishes loading.
hindi: next/image ka Image picture dikhata hai aur use screen ke hisaab se resize karta hai. public/logo.svg ka src "/logo.svg" hai. fill na ho to width aur height chahiye, taaki browser jagah rok le aur layout jump na ho.

alt unke liye text hai jo picture nahi dekh sakte. Khali alt sirf decorative picture par do. Pehli screen ki sabse badi image par priority use jaldi load karti hai. fill par sizes batata hai kaunsi width download karni hai.
Screen: logo 32 by 32 CSS pixels par dikhta hai. File load hone par layout jump nahi karta.

title: React Native
summary: React for iOS and Android, with native views instead of HTML.

lessons.title: Native views, not HTML
english: React Native uses React, but the host is a phone, not a browser. There is no div or span. View is a box, Text shows words, and Pressable handles taps.
Text must live inside a Text component. Putting a string directly in a View does not work the way a div does on the web.
The component model is the same idea as React: small functions, props in, UI out.
hindi: React Native React use karta hai, lekin host browser nahi, phone hai. Yahan div ya span nahi hota. View ek box hai, Text words dikhata hai, aur Pressable tap handle karta hai.
Text ko Text component ke andar hona chahiye. View ke andar seedha string web ke div ki tarah kaam nahi karta.
Component model React jaisa hi hai: chhote functions, props andar, UI bahar.

lessons.title: StyleSheet and flex
english: Styles are JavaScript objects, usually created with StyleSheet.create. Names are camelCase, so backgroundColor instead of background-color.
Layout uses flexbox, and the default direction is column. flex: 1 makes a view fill the space its parent offers.
There is no CSS cascade. Each component gets the styles you pass. Share tokens, such as colors, from one file.
hindi: Styles JavaScript objects hain, aksar StyleSheet.create se. Naam camelCase hote hain, isliye background-color ki jagah backgroundColor.
Layout flexbox use karta hai, aur default direction column hai. flex: 1 view ko parent ki khali jagah bharne deta hai.
Yahan CSS cascade nahi hai. Har component ko wahi styles milte hain jo aap dete ho. Colors jaise tokens ek file se share karo.

lessons.title: Screens and navigation
english: A mobile app is a stack of screens. React Navigation is the common library. A stack navigator pushes a screen and pops it when the user goes back.
Each screen is still a React component. Route params carry an id, the same job a URL segment does on the web.
Platform differences belong in a small place. Most UI can stay shared if you stick to View, Text, and Pressable.
hindi: Mobile app screens ka stack hota hai. React Navigation common library hai. Stack navigator screen push karta hai aur back par pop karta hai.
Har screen phir bhi ek React component hai. Route params id le jaate hain, jaise web par URL segment karta hai.
Platform differences chhoti jagah par rakho. Zyadatar UI View, Text, aur Pressable se shared reh sakta hai.

lessons.title: Pressable
english: Pressable is the tap target. onPress runs when the finger lifts inside the view. onPressIn runs when the finger goes down, onPressOut when it lifts, and onLongPress after a hold.
style can be a function. It receives { pressed }, so the background can change while the finger is down. disabled blocks every callback. hitSlop adds invisible pixels around a small target.
What you see: a short tap prints pressed. A hold prints long press. While the finger is down the button background is darker.
hindi: Pressable tap ka target hai. onPress tab chalta hai jab finger view ke andar uthhe. onPressIn finger neeche aate hi chalta hai, onPressOut uthte hi, aur onLongPress hold ke baad.

style function ho sakta hai. Use { pressed } milta hai, isliye finger neeche ho to background badal sakta hai. disabled har callback rok deta hai. hitSlop chhote target ke chaaron taraf invisible pixels jodta hai.
Screen: chhota tap pressed print karta hai. Hold long press print karta hai. Finger neeche ho to button ka background gehra ho jata hai.

lessons.title: TextInput
english: TextInput is the typed field. A controlled field stores the text in state. value is that state. onChangeText receives the next string, not an event. placeholder shows until the user types.
secureTextEntry hides a password. keyboardType="email-address" opens the email keyboard. autoCapitalize="none" leaves the letters as typed. multiline lets the field grow into several lines.
What you see: the field starts empty. Typing Ada shows Ada in the Text under the field.
hindi: TextInput typed field hai. Controlled field text state mein rakhta hai. value wahi state hai. onChangeText ko event nahi, next string milti hai. placeholder tab dikhta hai jab user ne kuch na likha ho.

secureTextEntry password chhupata hai. keyboardType="email-address" email keyboard kholta hai. autoCapitalize="none" letters ko jaise type kiye waise rehne deta hai. multiline field ko kai lines mein badalne deta hai.
Screen: field khaali shuru hota hai. Ada likhne par neeche Ada dikhta hai.

lessons.title: Switch
english: Switch is the on or off control. value is a boolean. onValueChange receives the next boolean. trackColor and thumbColor change the colors. disabled freezes the control.
Do not store the value only inside the switch. Keep it in state so the rest of the screen can read it.
What you see: the switch starts off and the label says Off. A tap turns it on and the label says On.
hindi: Switch on ya off control hai. value boolean hai. onValueChange ko next boolean milta hai. trackColor aur thumbColor colors badalte hain. disabled control ko rok deta hai.
Value sirf switch ke andar mat rakho. Use state mein rakho taaki screen ka baaki hissa padh sake.
Screen: switch off se shuru hota hai aur label Off kehta hai. Tap par on ho jata hai aur label On kehta hai.

lessons.title: Image
english: Image shows a picture. A file in the app is source={require("./logo.png")}. A remote file is source={{ uri: "https://example.com/logo.png" }}. A remote image needs width and height, or it collapses to nothing.
resizeMode="cover" fills the box and crops. contain fits the whole picture and may leave empty space. onLoad runs when the file is ready. onError runs when it fails.
What you see: the remote logo paints inside a 64 by 64 box. If the URL fails, the console prints image failed.
hindi: Image picture dikhata hai. App ki file source={require("./logo.png")} hai. Remote file source={{ uri: "https://example.com/logo.png" }} hai. Remote image ko width aur height chahiye, warna wo zero size ka ho jata hai.
resizeMode="cover" box bhar kar crop karta hai. contain poori picture fit karta hai aur khaali jagah chhod sakta hai. onLoad file ready hone par chalta hai. onError fail hone par.
Screen: remote logo 64 by 64 box mein dikhta hai. URL fail ho to console image failed print karta hai.

lessons.title: ScrollView
english: ScrollView renders every child at once and lets the user scroll. Use it for a short screen, such as a form. A long list of hundreds of rows belongs in FlatList, because ScrollView would mount all of them.
horizontal makes the scroll go sideways. contentContainerStyle styles the inner content, including padding. A ref can call scrollTo({ y: 0, animated: true }) to jump back to the top.
What you see: twenty numbered rows scroll vertically. Calling scrollTo moves the first row back into view.
hindi: ScrollView har child ko ek saath render karta hai aur user ko scroll karne deta hai. Chhoti screen ke liye use karo, jaise form. Sau rows ki list FlatList mein honi chahiye, kyunki ScrollView sabko mount kar deta hai.
horizontal scroll ko sideways karta hai. contentContainerStyle andar ke content ko style karta hai, padding bhi. Ref se scrollTo({ y: 0, animated: true }) top par wapas le jata hai.
Screen: bees numbered rows vertically scroll hoti hain. scrollTo pehli row ko wapas view mein laata hai.

lessons.title: FlatList
english: FlatList renders only the rows near the screen. data is the array. renderItem receives { item, index } and returns one row. keyExtractor returns a stable string id. Do not use the index as the key if rows can be inserted or removed.

ItemSeparatorComponent draws a line between rows. ListEmptyComponent shows when data is []. onEndReached runs as the user nears the bottom, which is where you load the next page. extraData must change when a row's look depends on state outside item.
What you see: data [{ id: "1", title: "React" }] shows one row, React. An empty array shows No lessons.
hindi: FlatList sirf screen ke paas ki rows render karta hai. data array hai. renderItem ko { item, index } milta hai aur wo ek row return karta hai. keyExtractor stable string id deta hai. Rows insert ya remove ho sakti hon to index ko key mat banao.

ItemSeparatorComponent rows ke beech line banata hai. ListEmptyComponent tab dikhta hai jab data [] ho. onEndReached user ke bottom ke paas pahunchte hi chalta hai, yahin next page load hota hai. extraData tab badalna chahiye jab row ka look item ke bahar ke state par depend kare.
Screen: data [{ id: "1", title: "React" }] ek row React dikhata hai. Khaali array No lessons dikhata hai.

lessons.title: SectionList
english: SectionList is a FlatList split into groups. sections is an array of { title, data }. renderSectionHeader receives { section } and draws the group title. renderItem still receives { item } and draws one row.
Sticky headers stay at the top while that group scrolls. keyExtractor still needs a stable id. Use this when rows have headings, such as Basics and Hooks, instead of flattening them into one array.
What you see: a Basics header, then the row Components, then a Hooks header, then the row useState.
hindi: SectionList groups mein bati FlatList hai. sections { title, data } ki array hai. renderSectionHeader ko { section } milta hai aur wo group title banata hai. renderItem ko phir bhi { item } milta hai aur wo ek row banata hai.
Sticky headers us group ke scroll ke dauran top par rehte hain. keyExtractor ko stable id chahiye. Rows ke headings hon, jaise Basics aur Hooks, to unhe ek array mein mat milaao.
Screen: Basics header, phir row Components, phir Hooks header, phir row useState.

lessons.title: Alert
english: Alert.alert(title, message, buttons) opens the system dialog. Each button is { text, onPress, style }. style "cancel" is the safe dismiss. style "destructive" marks a delete. A button with no style is the default action.
On iOS you can pass several buttons. On Android, three buttons is the practical limit. The dialog is not a React component, so it does not take style props from your theme.
What you see: tapping Delete opens a dialog titled Delete lesson. Cancel closes it and prints nothing. Delete prints deleted.
hindi: Alert.alert(title, message, buttons) system dialog kholta hai. Har button { text, onPress, style } hai. style "cancel" safe dismiss hai. style "destructive" delete ko mark karta hai. Bina style ka button default action hai.
iOS par kai buttons de sakte ho. Android par teen buttons practical limit hai. Dialog React component nahi hai, isliye theme ke style props nahi leta.
Screen: Delete tap karne par Delete lesson title wala dialog khulta hai. Cancel use band karta hai aur kuch print nahi hota. Delete deleted print karta hai.

lessons.title: Modal and ActivityIndicator
english: Modal covers the screen with another tree. visible shows or hides it. animationType is "none", "slide", or "fade". onRequestClose runs when Android's back button tries to close it, so set visible to false there. transparent lets the page show through.
ActivityIndicator is the spinner. animating={false} hides the motion. size is "small" or "large". color sets the spinner color. Put it in the place where data has not arrived yet.
What you see: loading true shows a large teal spinner and no dialog. Opening the modal shows the text Notes on top of the page. Back on Android hides it.
hindi: Modal screen ko doosre tree se cover karta hai. visible use dikhata ya chhupata hai. animationType "none", "slide", ya "fade" hai. onRequestClose Android ke back button par chalta hai, wahan visible false karo. transparent page ko neeche dikhne deta hai.
ActivityIndicator spinner hai. animating={false} motion chhupa deta hai. size "small" ya "large" hai. color spinner ka color hai. Use wahan rakho jahan data abhi nahi aaya.
Screen: loading true bada teal spinner dikhata hai, dialog nahi. Modal kholne par page ke upar Notes dikhta hai. Android back use chhupa deta hai.

lessons.title: Platform and useWindowDimensions
english: Platform.OS is "ios" or "android". Platform.select({ ios, android, default }) picks one value. Use it for a small difference, such as padding, not for a second copy of the screen.

useWindowDimensions() returns { width, height, scale, fontScale } and updates when the window changes, including rotation. Dimensions.get("window") reads once and does not follow rotation unless you subscribe yourself.
What you see: an iPhone shows the label ios. A phone rotated from portrait to landscape changes the printed width.
hindi: Platform.OS "ios" ya "android" hota hai. Platform.select({ ios, android, default }) ek value chunta hai. Chhota farq, jaise padding, isi se rakho. Poori screen ki doosri copy mat banao.

useWindowDimensions() { width, height, scale, fontScale } deta hai aur window badalne par update hota hai, rotation bhi. Dimensions.get("window") ek baar padhta hai aur rotation ke saath nahi badalta jab tak aap khud subscribe na karo.
Screen: iPhone par label ios dikhta hai. Portrait se landscape rotate karne par printed width badal jati hai.

lessons.title: Linking
english: Linking.openURL(url) asks the system to open a URL. https opens the browser. mailto opens mail. tel opens the phone dialer. The returned promise rejects when no app can handle that URL.

Linking.canOpenURL(url) resolves to true when some app claims the scheme. On iOS a custom scheme must be listed in the query schemes before canOpenURL will say true. Get the URL that opened the app with Linking.getInitialURL().
What you see: tapping Email opens the mail composer addressed to ada@example.com. A bad scheme rejects and the console prints cannot open.
hindi: Linking.openURL(url) system se URL khulwata hai. https browser kholta hai. mailto mail kholta hai. tel dialer kholta hai. Koi app us URL ko handle na kare to promise reject hota hai.

Linking.canOpenURL(url) true deta hai jab koi app us scheme ko claim kare. iOS par custom scheme ko query schemes mein likhna padta hai, tabhi canOpenURL true kehta hai. App ko kholne wala URL Linking.getInitialURL() se milta hai.
Screen: Email tap karne par mail composer ada@example.com par khulta hai. Galat scheme reject hota hai aur console cannot open print karta hai.

lessons.title: KeyboardAvoidingView
english: The keyboard covers the bottom of the screen. KeyboardAvoidingView adds space so the focused field stays visible. behavior is "padding" on iOS and often "height" on Android. keyboardVerticalOffset is extra pixels when a header already uses some of the top.
A ScrollView inside it lets a long form move. Keyboard.dismiss() closes the keyboard from a tap outside the field.
What you see: focusing the bottom field on a phone slides the form up. The field stays above the keyboard instead of hiding under it.
hindi: Keyboard screen ke neeche ko cover kar deta hai. KeyboardAvoidingView jagah jodta hai taaki focused field dikhti rahe. behavior iOS par "padding" hai aur Android par aksar "height". keyboardVerticalOffset extra pixels hain jab header upar ki jagah le chuka ho.
Andar ScrollView lamba form move karne deta hai. Keyboard.dismiss() field ke bahar tap se keyboard band karta hai.
Screen: phone par neeche ki field focus karne se form upar slide hota hai. Field keyboard ke neeche chhupti nahi.

lessons.title: Animated
english: Animated.Value holds a number that can change without a React render. Animated.View reads it in a style. Animated.timing(value, { toValue, duration, useNativeDriver: true }).start() moves the number over duration milliseconds. useNativeDriver: true runs opacity and transform on the native thread.

Animated.spring uses speed instead of a fixed duration. start takes a callback that receives { finished }. Call stop() to cancel. Not every style can use the native driver. width and backgroundColor need useNativeDriver: false.
What you see: the box starts invisible. Over 300 milliseconds its opacity becomes 1, so it fades in.
hindi: Animated.Value woh number rakhta hai jo React render ke bina badal sake. Animated.View use style mein padhta hai. Animated.timing(value, { toValue, duration, useNativeDriver: true }).start() number ko duration milliseconds mein move karta hai. useNativeDriver: true opacity aur transform ko native thread par chalata hai.

Animated.spring fixed duration ki jagah speed use karta hai. start ka callback { finished } leta hai. Roko to stop() call karo. Har style native driver use nahi kar sakta. width aur backgroundColor ke liye useNativeDriver: false chahiye.
Screen: box invisible shuru hota hai. 300 milliseconds mein opacity 1 ho jati hai, yaani fade in.

title: MongoDB
summary: Store documents in collections and query them.

lessons.title: Documents and collections
english: MongoDB stores JSON-like documents. A document is a set of fields. Related documents live in a collection, similar to rows in a table, but each document can have a different shape.
Every document has an _id. If you do not set one, MongoDB creates an ObjectId.
A database holds many collections. One app often uses one database and a collection per kind of thing, such as users or lessons.
hindi: MongoDB JSON jaise documents store karta hai. Document fields ka set hai. Related documents ek collection mein rehte hain. Ye table ki rows jaisa hai, lekin har document ka shape alag ho sakta hai.
Har document ka _id hota hai. Aap na do to MongoDB ObjectId bana deta hai.
Ek database mein kai collections hoti hain. Aksar ek app ek database use karti hai, aur har cheez ki alag collection, jaise users ya lessons.

lessons.title: Create, read, update, delete
english: insertOne adds a document. find looks up documents. findOne returns the first match. updateOne changes fields. deleteOne removes a document.
A filter is a query object. { topic: "MongoDB" } matches documents whose topic field equals that string.
$set changes only the fields you name. Without it, a naive replace can wipe the rest of the document.
hindi: insertOne document add karta hai. find documents dhoondhta hai. findOne pehla match deta hai. updateOne fields badalta hai. deleteOne document hata deta hai.
Filter ek query object hai. { topic: "MongoDB" } un documents ko match karta hai jinka topic field wahi string hai.
$set sirf un fields ko badalta hai jinhe aap naam dete ho. Bina iske poora document replace ho sakta hai aur baaki fields mit sakti hain.

lessons.title: Useful queries
english: Comparison operators live under a field. $gt means greater than, $in means one of these values, and $ne means not equal.
sort, skip, and limit shape the result. Sort by a field, skip earlier pages, and limit the page size.
An index on a field you filter or sort by keeps the query fast as the collection grows. The _id field is indexed already.
hindi: Comparison operators field ke andar likhe jaate hain. $gt ka matlab greater than, $in ka matlab in values mein se ek, aur $ne ka matlab not equal.
sort, skip, aur limit result ko shape karte hain. Field se sort karo, pichhle pages skip karo, aur page size limit karo.
Jis field par filter ya sort karte ho, us par index query ko tez rakhta hai jab collection badi ho. _id pehle se indexed hai.
lessons.code:
await lessons
  .find({ topic: "MongoDB" })
  .sort({ title: 1 })
  .limit(10)
  .toArray();

lessons.title: Sample users
english: The next lessons use one users collection. Ada and Grace are admins. Lin is a member. tags is an array of strings.
A filter such as { name: "Ada" } matches one document. A filter such as { role: "admin" } matches Ada and Grace.
hindi: Agle lessons ek users collection use karte hain. Ada aur Grace admin hain. Lin member hai. tags strings ki array hai.
{ name: "Ada" } ek document match karta hai. { role: "admin" } Ada aur Grace dono ko match karta hai.

lessons.title: insertOne
english: insertOne(document) adds one document. If you omit _id, MongoDB creates an ObjectId. The result tells you the new id. acknowledged true means the server accepted the write.
A required field is your rule, not MongoDB's. The database will store a document that is missing name unless your schema rejects it.
What you get: insertedId is the new document's _id. A following findOne({ name: "Bea" }) returns that document.
hindi: insertOne(document) ek document add karta hai. _id na do to MongoDB ObjectId banata hai. Result naya id batata hai. acknowledged true ka matlab server ne write accept kar liya.
Required field aapka rule hai, MongoDB ka nahi. Database name ke bina bhi document rakh lega jab tak schema use reject na kare.
Result: insertedId naye document ka _id hai. Uske baad findOne({ name: "Bea" }) wahi document deta hai.

lessons.title: insertMany
english: insertMany(documents) adds the whole array. insertedCount is how many were written. insertedIds maps each array index to an _id. The default is ordered: true, so a bad document stops the rest.
Pass { ordered: false } when a duplicate should not cancel the other inserts. Those still succeed, and the error lists the ones that failed.
What you get: two documents in, insertedCount 2.
hindi: insertMany(documents) poori array add karta hai. insertedCount batata hai kitne likhe gaye. insertedIds har index ko _id se jodta hai. Default ordered: true hai, isliye ek kharab document baaki ko rok deta hai.
{ ordered: false } tab do jab duplicate baaki inserts ko cancel na kare. Jo theek hon wo likh jaate hain, aur error unki list deta hai jo fail hue.
Result: do documents in, insertedCount 2.

lessons.title: updateOne and updateMany
english: $set writes the fields you name and leaves the rest. $unset removes a field. $inc adds a number. A positive number increases it. A negative number decreases it.

updateOne changes the first match. updateMany changes every match. Without an operator, the update object is rejected. matchedCount is how many matched. modifiedCount is how many actually changed. Setting a field to the value it already has leaves modifiedCount at 0.
What you get: updateOne on Ada with $inc age by 1 returns matchedCount 1 and modifiedCount 1. Ada's age becomes 37. updateMany on role admin with $set active true changes Ada and Grace.
hindi: $set sirf naam diye fields likhta hai aur baaki rehne deta hai. $unset field hata deta hai. $inc number jodta hai. Positive number badhata hai. Negative number ghatata hai.

updateOne pehla match badalta hai. updateMany har match badalta hai. Bina operator ke update object reject ho jata hai. matchedCount kitne match hue. modifiedCount kitne sach mein badle. Jo field pehle se wahi value ho us par modifiedCount 0 rehta hai.
Result: Ada par $inc age 1 se matchedCount 1 aur modifiedCount 1. Ada ki age 37 ho jati hai. role admin par updateMany Ada aur Grace dono ko active true karta hai.

lessons.title: $push, $pull, and $addToSet
english: $push appends a value to an array. $push with $each appends several. $pull removes every element that matches. $addToSet appends only when the value is not already there.
These operators change the array in the database. You do not load the document, edit the array in JavaScript, and save the whole document back.
What you get: $addToSet "js" on Ada leaves tags as ["js", "react"] because js is already there. $pull "react" leaves ["js"]. $push "node" leaves ["js", "node"].
hindi: $push array mein value jodta hai. $each ke saath kai values jodta hai. $pull har woh element hata deta hai jo match kare. $addToSet tabhi jodta hai jab value pehle se na ho.
Ye operators array ko database mein badalte hain. Document load karke JavaScript mein array edit karke poora document wapas save karne ki zaroorat nahi.
Result: Ada par $addToSet "js" tags ko ["js", "react"] hi rehne deta hai. $pull "react" ["js"] chhodta hai. $push "node" ["js", "node"] chhodta hai.

lessons.title: replaceOne and findOneAndUpdate
english: replaceOne(filter, document) swaps the whole document except _id. Fields you leave out are deleted. Use updateOne with $set when you only want to change a few fields.

findOneAndUpdate(filter, update, options) changes one document and returns it. returnDocument: "after" returns the new document. "before" returns the old one. upsert: true inserts a document when nothing matches.
What you get: findOneAndUpdate on Lin with $set age 29 and returnDocument "after" returns the Lin document with age 29.
hindi: replaceOne(filter, document) _id ko chhod kar poora document badal deta hai. Jo fields chhod doge wo delete ho jati hain. Sirf kuch fields badalni hon to updateOne aur $set use karo.
findOneAndUpdate ek document badalta hai aur use return karta hai. returnDocument: "after" naya document deta hai. "before" purana deta hai. upsert: true tab insert karta hai jab kuch match na ho.
Result: Lin par $set age 29 aur returnDocument "after" Lin ka document age 29 ke saath return karta hai.

lessons.title: deleteOne and deleteMany
english: deleteOne(filter) removes the first match. deleteMany(filter) removes every match. deletedCount is how many were removed. A filter that matches nothing returns deletedCount 0 and does not throw.
deleteMany({}) removes every document in the collection. Pass a filter unless you mean to empty it.
What you get: deleteOne({ name: "Lin" }) returns deletedCount 1. deleteMany({ role: "admin" }) returns deletedCount 2.
hindi: deleteOne(filter) pehla match hata deta hai. deleteMany(filter) har match hata deta hai. deletedCount batata hai kitne hate. Jo filter kuch match na kare wo deletedCount 0 deta hai aur throw nahi karta.
deleteMany({}) collection ka har document hata deta hai. Collection khali karni ho tabhi aisa filter do.
Result: deleteOne({ name: "Lin" }) deletedCount 1 deta hai. deleteMany({ role: "admin" }) deletedCount 2 deta hai.

lessons.title: findOneAndDelete
english: findOneAndDelete(filter) removes one document and returns it. Use it when you need the deleted data, such as its _id, before it is gone. deleteOne only returns a count.
The sort option decides which document goes when several match. { age: -1 } deletes the oldest match.
What you get: findOneAndDelete({ role: "member" }) returns the Lin document, and a later findOne for Lin returns null.
hindi: findOneAndDelete(filter) ek document hata kar use return karta hai. Jab deleted data chahiye, jaise uska _id, tab use karo. deleteOne sirf count deta hai.
sort option batata hai kai match mein se kaun sa jaaye. { age: -1 } sabse badi age wala match delete karta hai.
Result: findOneAndDelete({ role: "member" }) Lin ka document return karta hai, aur baad mein Lin ka findOne null deta hai.

lessons.title: Comparison operators
english: $eq is equal. You can also write { role: "admin" }, which means the same thing. $ne is not equal. $gt, $gte, $lt, and $lte compare numbers and dates. $in matches any value in the list. $nin matches none of them.
Put the operator under the field name. { age: { $gte: 36 } } is age greater than or equal to 36.
What you get: age $gte 36 returns Ada and Grace. role $in ["member"] returns Lin. role $ne "admin" also returns Lin.
hindi: $eq equal hai. { role: "admin" } bhi wahi matlab hai. $ne not equal hai. $gt, $gte, $lt, aur $lte numbers aur dates compare karte hain. $in list ki kisi bhi value se match karta hai. $nin unmein se kisi se match nahi karta.
Operator field ke naam ke andar likho. { age: { $gte: 36 } } ka matlab age 36 ya usse badi.
Result: age $gte 36 Ada aur Grace deta hai. role $in ["member"] Lin deta hai. role $ne "admin" bhi Lin deta hai.

lessons.title: $and, $or, and $nor
english: Two fields in one object are combined with and. { role: "admin", age: { $gte: 40 } } needs both. $or takes an array and matches a document that fits any object in it. $and is the explicit form when one field needs two operators. $nor matches documents that fit none of the objects.
A field cannot hold two operators as two keys of one object if you write the field twice. The second key wins. Use $and for that case.
What you get: role admin and age at least 40 returns Grace. $or of role member or age at least 45 returns Lin and Grace.
hindi: Ek object ki do fields and se judti hain. { role: "admin", age: { $gte: 40 } } ko dono chahiye. $or array leta hai aur us document ko match karta hai jo kisi ek object par fit ho. $and tab chahiye jab ek field par do operators hon. $nor un documents ko match karta hai jo kisi object par fit na hon.
Ek field ko ek object mein do baar likhoge to doosri key jeet jati hai. Us case mein $and use karo.
Result: role admin aur age kam se kam 40 Grace deta hai. role member ya age kam se kam 45 Lin aur Grace deta hai.

lessons.title: $exists, $type, and $regex
english: $exists: true matches documents that have the field, even when the value is null. $exists: false matches documents that do not have it. $type matches the BSON type, such as "string" or "array".

$regex matches a string. { name: { $regex: "^A" } } is a name that starts with A. Add $options: "i" for a case-insensitive match. An index can speed up a prefix regex. A regex that starts with a wild card does not use the index the same way.
What you get: tags $exists true returns Ada, Grace, and Lin. name $regex "^A" returns Ada.
hindi: $exists: true un documents ko match karta hai jinke paas field ho, chahe value null ho. $exists: false unhe match karta hai jinke paas field na ho. $type BSON type match karta hai, jaise "string" ya "array".

$regex string match karta hai. { name: { $regex: "^A" } } woh name hai jo A se shuru ho. Case-insensitive ke liye $options: "i" jodo. Prefix regex index use kar sakta hai. Jo regex wild card se shuru ho wo index usi tarah use nahi karta.
Result: tags $exists true Ada, Grace, aur Lin deta hai. name $regex "^A" Ada deta hai.

lessons.title: Projection
english: A projection chooses which fields come back. In the driver, pass { projection: { name: 1, age: 1, _id: 0 } }. 1 includes a field. 0 excludes it. _id is included unless you set it to 0.
Do not mix include and exclude in one projection, except for excluding _id. The server rejects that mix.
What you get: the query returns { name: "Ada", age: 36 } with no role, tags, or _id.
hindi: Projection batati hai kaun si fields wapas aayen. Driver mein { projection: { name: 1, age: 1, _id: 0 } } do. 1 field rakhta hai. 0 field hata deta hai. _id tabhi hatta hai jab use 0 do.
Ek projection mein include aur exclude mat milao, sirf _id hatane ke alawa. Server us mix ko reject karta hai.
Result: query { name: "Ada", age: 36 } deti hai, role, tags, ya _id nahi.

lessons.title: sort, skip, and limit
english: find() returns a cursor. sort, skip, and limit shape it before toArray() reads the documents. sort({ age: 1 }) is ascending. sort({ age: -1 }) is descending. skip drops the first n matches. limit keeps only n.
Skip grows slow on a large page number because the server still walks the skipped documents. A range on an indexed field is the usual replacement for deep pages.
What you get: sort age descending, skip 0, limit 1 returns Grace, age 45. limit 2 returns Grace then Ada.
hindi: find() cursor deta hai. sort, skip, aur limit use toArray() se pehle shape karte hain. sort({ age: 1 }) chhote se bade ki taraf hai. sort({ age: -1 }) bade se chhote ki taraf. skip pehle n matches chhodta hai. limit sirf n rakhta hai.
Badi page number par skip slow hota hai kyunki server chhode hue documents par bhi chalta hai. Indexed field par range gehre pages ki jagah use hoti hai.
Result: age descending, skip 0, limit 1 Grace deta hai, age 45. limit 2 Grace phir Ada deta hai.
lessons.code:
await users.find().sort({ age: -1 }).limit(2).toArray();
// Grace age 45, then Ada age 36

lessons.title: countDocuments and distinct
english: countDocuments(filter) counts documents that match. It can use the same filter as find. estimatedDocumentCount() reads collection metadata and ignores a filter, so it is faster and only right when you want the whole collection.
distinct(field, filter) returns each different value of that field once. The result is an array of values, not documents.
What you get: countDocuments({ role: "admin" }) is 2. distinct("role") is ["admin", "member"].
hindi: countDocuments(filter) match hone wale documents ginta hai. Filter wahi ho sakta hai jo find mein hota hai. estimatedDocumentCount() collection metadata padhta hai aur filter ignore karta hai, isliye tez hai aur tabhi sahi hai jab poori collection chahiye.
distinct(field, filter) us field ki har alag value ek baar deta hai. Result values ki array hai, documents ki nahi.
Result: countDocuments({ role: "admin" }) 2 hai. distinct("role") ["admin", "member"] hai.

lessons.title: $match and $group
english: aggregate(pipeline) runs stages in order. Each stage receives the documents from the stage before it. $match keeps documents, using the same filter language as find. $group bundles them by _id.
$sum: 1 counts the documents in a group. $avg averages a field. A missing field in $avg is skipped, not treated as 0.
What you get: group by role returns admin with count 2, and member with count 1.
hindi: aggregate(pipeline) stages ko order mein chalata hai. Har stage ko pichhli stage ke documents milte hain. $match documents rakhta hai, find jaisi filter language se. $group unhe _id se bundle karta hai.
$sum: 1 group ke documents ginta hai. $avg field ka average nikalta hai. $avg mein missing field 0 nahi banti, skip hoti hai.
Result: role par group admin count 2 aur member count 1 deta hai.

lessons.title: $project, $sort, and $limit
english: $project builds the output document. name: 1 keeps a field. ageNext: { $add: ["$age", 1] } writes a new field. _id: 0 drops the id. $sort and $limit work like the cursor methods, but inside the pipeline.
Put $match before $sort and $limit when you can. The server then sorts fewer documents.
What you get: admins sorted by age descending, limited to 1, come back as { name: "Grace", age: 45 }.
hindi: $project output document banata hai. name: 1 field rakhta hai. ageNext: { $add: ["$age", 1] } naya field likhta hai. _id: 0 id hata deta hai. $sort aur $limit cursor methods ki tarah kaam karte hain, pipeline ke andar.
$match ko $sort aur $limit se pehle rakho jab ho sake. Server kam documents sort karta hai.
Result: admins age descending, limit 1, { name: "Grace", age: 45 } aata hai.

lessons.title: $lookup
english: $lookup joins another collection. from is that collection. localField is the field on the current document. foreignField is the field on the other collection. as is the new array that holds the matches.
A user named Ada and an order whose user field is Ada produce an orders array on Ada's document. A user with no orders gets an empty array, not a missing field.
What you get: Ada's document includes orders [{ item: "book", total: 12 }]. Lin's orders array is [].
hindi: $lookup doosri collection join karta hai. from woh collection hai. localField current document ka field hai. foreignField doosri collection ka field hai. as nayi array hai jisme matches aate hain.
Ada naam ka user aur woh order jiska user field Ada ho, Ada ke document par orders array banate hain. Jis user ke orders na hon use khaali array milti hai, missing field nahi.
Result: Ada ke document mein orders [{ item: "book", total: 12 }] aata hai. Lin ki orders array [] hai.

lessons.title: createIndex
english: createIndex(keys) builds an index. { age: 1 } is ascending. { age: -1 } is descending. The call returns the index name, such as age_1. find and sort on that field can then use the index instead of scanning every document.
An index speeds reads and slows writes, because every insert and update must maintain it. Index a field you filter or sort by often.
What you get: createIndex({ age: 1 }) returns "age_1".
hindi: createIndex(keys) index banata hai. { age: 1 } ascending hai. { age: -1 } descending hai. Call index ka naam return karti hai, jaise age_1. Us field par find aur sort phir har document scan karne ki jagah index use kar sakte hain.
Index reads tez karta hai aur writes slow, kyunki har insert aur update ko use maintain karna padta hai. Woh field index karo jisse aksar filter ya sort karte ho.
Result: createIndex({ age: 1 }) "age_1" return karta hai.
lessons.code:
const name = await users.createIndex({ age: 1 });
// "age_1"

lessons.title: Unique and compound indexes
english: createIndex({ email: 1 }, { unique: true }) rejects a second document with the same email. The error code is 11000. Missing email values are indexed too, and only one document may omit the field unless the index is sparse or partial.
A compound index uses several fields in order. { role: 1, age: -1 } serves a filter on role, and a filter on role plus a sort on age. It does not by itself serve a filter on age alone.
What you get: the second insert of email ada@example.com throws a duplicate key error. The first document stays.
hindi: createIndex({ email: 1 }, { unique: true }) same email wala doosra document reject karta hai. Error code 11000 hai. Missing email bhi index hoti hai, aur sirf ek document field chhod sakta hai jab tak index sparse ya partial na ho.
Compound index kai fields ko order mein use karta hai. { role: 1, age: -1 } role par filter chalata hai, aur role ke filter ke saath age par sort bhi. Sirf age par filter apne aap nahi chalta.
Result: email ada@example.com ka doosra insert duplicate key error throw karta hai. Pehla document rehta hai.

lessons.title: bulkWrite
english: bulkWrite(operations) sends several writes in one call. Each item is insertOne, updateOne, updateMany, replaceOne, deleteOne, or deleteMany. The default is ordered, so a failure stops the later operations.
The result counts each kind of write. insertedCount, matchedCount, modifiedCount, and deletedCount are separate.
What you get: one insert, one update of Ada, and one delete of Lin return insertedCount 1, matchedCount 1, modifiedCount 1, and deletedCount 1.
hindi: bulkWrite(operations) kai writes ek call mein bhejta hai. Har item insertOne, updateOne, updateMany, replaceOne, deleteOne, ya deleteMany hai. Default ordered hai, isliye failure baad ki operations rok deta hai.
Result har tarah ki write alag ginta hai. insertedCount, matchedCount, modifiedCount, aur deletedCount alag hain.
Result: ek insert, Ada ka ek update, aur Lin ka ek delete insertedCount 1, matchedCount 1, modifiedCount 1, aur deletedCount 1 dete hain.

title: Mongoose
summary: Schemas, models, and validation on top of MongoDB.

lessons.title: Schemas
english: Mongoose is a library for Node that describes the shape of a MongoDB document. A schema lists fields, their types, and rules such as required or unique.
MongoDB itself will store almost any shape. The schema is your app's contract, so bad data is rejected before it is saved.
Default values and timestamps can be declared once on the schema instead of repeated in every insert.
hindi: Mongoose Node ki library hai jo MongoDB document ka shape batati hai. Schema fields, unke types, aur rules likhta hai, jaise required ya unique.
MongoDB khud lagbhag koi bhi shape rakh leta hai. Schema aapki app ka contract hai, isliye galat data save hone se pehle reject ho jata hai.
Default values aur timestamps schema par ek baar likh sakte ho, har insert mein dohrane ki zaroorat nahi.

lessons.title: Models and validation
english: A model is a constructor compiled from a schema. It is tied to a collection. Lesson.create inserts a document and runs validators first.
If a required field is missing, save fails with a validation error. Read error.errors to see which fields failed.
Connect once when the app starts, with mongoose.connect and your database URL. Do not open a new connection on every request.
hindi: Model schema se bana constructor hai. Ye ek collection se juda hota hai. Lesson.create document insert karta hai aur pehle validators chalata hai.
Required field missing ho to save validation error ke saath fail hota hai. error.errors se pata chalta hai kaunse fields fail hue.
App start par mongoose.connect se ek baar connect karo, apne database URL ke saath. Har request par naya connection mat kholo.

lessons.title: References between documents
english: A field can store another document's id. In the schema, set the type to ObjectId and ref to the other model name.
populate replaces that id with the related document when you query. Use it when the screen needs both records.
Do not populate everything by default. Extra joins cost time. Load the related document only on the route that needs it.
hindi: Ek field doosre document ki id rakh sakti hai. Schema mein type ObjectId rakho aur ref mein doosre model ka naam.
populate query ke time us id ki jagah related document laga deta hai. Jab screen ko dono records chahiye, tab use karo.
Sab kuch by default populate mat karo. Extra joins time lete hain. Related document sirf us route par load karo jise uski zaroorat hai.

lessons.title: Connection methods
english: Call mongoose.connect(uri) once when the app starts. It returns a promise that resolves when the pool is ready. mongoose.disconnect() closes it. connection.close() does the same on the default connection.

connection.on('connected'), on('error'), on('disconnected'), and on('reconnected') report state. connection.readyState is 0 disconnected, 1 connected, 2 connecting, 3 disconnecting. mongoose.createConnection(uri) opens a second connection if one process talks to two databases.

mongoose.set('strictQuery', true) strips unknown filter fields. mongoose.set('debug', true) prints each query. mongoose.startSession() opens a session for transactions. mongoose.model(name, schema) compiles a model. mongoose.modelNames() lists those names. mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(value) checks an id string.
Output: after a successful connect, readyState is 1. modelNames() includes the models you compiled, such as Lesson.
hindi: mongoose.connect(uri) app start par ek baar call karo. Ye promise deta hai. mongoose.disconnect() connection band karta hai. connection.close() default connection band karta hai.

connection.on('connected'), on('error'), on('disconnected'), aur on('reconnected') state batate hain. readyState 0 disconnected, 1 connected, 2 connecting, 3 disconnecting hai. mongoose.createConnection doosra database kholta hai.

mongoose.set('strictQuery', true) anjaan filter fields hata deta hai. mongoose.set('debug', true) query print karta hai. mongoose.startSession() transaction ke liye session kholta hai. mongoose.model model banata hai. mongoose.modelNames() naam list karta hai.
Output: successful connect ke baad readyState 1 hota hai.

lessons.title: Schema methods
english: new mongoose.Schema(definition, options) builds the contract. schema.add(fields) adds paths later. schema.path(name) reads one path. schema.eachPath(fn) visits every path. schema.remove(path) deletes a path. schema.requiredPaths() lists required names.

schema.method(name, fn) and schema.methods add document functions. schema.static(name, fn) and schema.statics add model functions. schema.query.set(name, fn) adds a chainable query helper. schema.virtual(name).get(fn).set(fn) adds a field that is not stored. schema.alias(from, to) gives a path a second name.

schema.plugin(fn) runs a plugin. schema.pre(hook, fn) and schema.post(hook, fn) register middleware. schema.index(fields) declares an index. schema.indexes() lists them. schema.loadClass(Class) copies class methods onto the schema. schema.clone() copies the schema. schema.pick(paths) and schema.omit(paths) build a smaller schema. schema.set(key, value) and schema.get(key) read options such as timestamps.
Output: a virtual fullName get returns the joined first and last name. The stored document still has no fullName field until you turn virtuals on in toJSON.
hindi: new mongoose.Schema contract banata hai. schema.add paths jodta hai. schema.path ek path padhta hai. schema.eachPath har path par chalta hai. schema.requiredPaths required naam deta hai.

schema.method document function jodta hai. schema.static model function jodta hai. schema.query chain helper jodta hai. schema.virtual aisa field hai jo database mein save nahi hota. schema.alias path ko doosra naam deta hai.

schema.plugin plugin chalata hai. schema.pre aur schema.post middleware lagate hain. schema.index index banata hai. schema.loadClass class methods copy karta hai. schema.pick aur schema.omit chhota schema banate hain.
Output: virtual fullName joda hua naam deta hai. Database mein fullName tab tak nahi hota jab tak toJSON mein virtuals on na karo.

lessons.title: Create and insert methods
english: Model.create(doc) validates and inserts one document, or an array of documents. new Model(doc) only builds the object in memory. doc.save() validates and inserts it. Model.insertMany(docs) inserts many and, by default, validates each one. ordered:false keeps going after one failure.

Model.bulkWrite(ops) sends mixed insert, update, and delete operations in one round trip. Model.hydrate(plain) wraps a plain object as a document without hitting the database. Model.validate(obj) checks the object and does not save it.
Output: User.create({ name: 'Ada' }) returns a document whose name is Ada and whose _id is a new ObjectId. insertMany of two users makes countDocuments() return 2.
hindi: Model.create validate karke insert karta hai. new Model sirf memory mein object banata hai. doc.save() use validate karke save karta hai. Model.insertMany kai documents insert karta hai. Model.bulkWrite mix operations ek saath bhejta hai. Model.hydrate plain object ko document banata hai, database ko touch kiye bina. Model.validate save nahi karta, sirf check karta hai.
Output: User.create({ name: 'Ada' }) ka name Ada hota hai aur _id naya ObjectId hota hai. Do users insertMany ke baad countDocuments() 2 deta hai.

lessons.title: Find methods
english: Model.find(filter) returns a Query that resolves to an array. An empty filter returns every document. Model.findOne(filter) returns the first match or null. Model.findById(id) is findOne({ _id: id }). Model.exists(filter) returns { _id } or null, and does not load the whole document.

Model.countDocuments(filter) counts matches. Model.estimatedDocumentCount() is a fast collection count and ignores the filter. Model.distinct(field, filter) returns the unique values of one field. Model.where(field) starts a query chain. Model.watch() opens a change stream of inserts, updates, and deletes.
The old Model.count() is deprecated. Use countDocuments. find does not throw when nothing matches. It returns []. findOne returns null.
Output: find({ role: 'admin' }) prints an array. If Ada is the only admin, the array length is 1 and the first name is Ada. findOne({ name: 'Missing' }) prints null.
hindi: Model.find array deta hai. Model.findOne pehla match ya null deta hai. Model.findById id se dhoondhta hai. Model.exists sirf { _id } ya null deta hai. Model.countDocuments count deta hai. Model.estimatedDocumentCount tez collection count hai. Model.distinct unique values deta hai. Model.where chain shuru karta hai. Model.watch changes sunta hai.
Purana Model.count use mat karo. countDocuments use karo. Kuch na mile to find [] deta hai aur findOne null.
Output: ek admin Ada ho to find ka length 1 hota hai. Missing naam par findOne null hota hai.

lessons.title: Query helper methods
english: find and findOne return a Query.
